measurements.evidence_quote: Fig. 4a and b show the zeta potential vs. pH for PS (20 mg L-1) and PDA (0.6 mg/6 mL) samples, respectively. || From zeta potential studies of PS and PDA at pH values ranging from 2 to 9, it is suggested that PDA can interact with and assist in the charge neutralisation of PS at acidic pH conditions (pH 2 and 3). || All the experiments were conducted using deionised water unless explicitly stated. || The Malvern zeta potential instrument was utilised to examine the surface charges of PS nanoplastics and PDA at various pH values.
